uk.s: STABLE Futures Carnival · Trade & Win Up to 2,130 USDT!
The STABLE Futures Carnival is officially live! Trade STABLEUSDT Perpetual Futures, complete campaign tasks, and unlock tiered rewards worth up to 2,130 USDT.
Trade STABLEUSDT Perpetual Futures, reach trading volume milestones, complete campaign tasks, and earn more rewards throughout the campaign.
STABLE Futures Trading Milestone: Up to 2,020 USDT
Complete campaign tasks and tradeSTABLEUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign.
Trade STABLEUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign. Cumulative trading volume includes both opening and closing orders, as well as Long and Short positions.

Rewards from all unlocked tiers are cumulative. For example, if a user reaches 10,000 USDT in cumulative STABLEUSDT Futures trading volume, they will unlock the corresponding milestone and receive the total rewards from all unlocked tiers.
Complete campaign tasks to earn additional rewards, including Cumulative Deposit Tasks, First STABLEUSDT Futures Trade, and Invite Friends.
